name: amfx-eurusd-btp-bund-spread
description: amFX reproduction (17JUN22 p1): EURUSD vs Germany/Italy 10-year spread (BTP-Bund). Shows how peripheral spreads drive EUR -- when Italy/Germany spread widens, EUR sells off. ECB anti-fragmentation pledge was tightening spreads, supporting EUR buy thesis. Spread inverted to show directional alignment with EURUSD.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: EURUSD vs BTP-BUND SPREAD (17JUN22 p1)
# =============================================================================
# Brent Donnelly's EUR buy-the-dip thesis:
# - ECB anti-fragmentation pledge tightening peripheral spreads
# - Italy/Germany 10Y spread (BTP-Bund) co-moves with EURUSD
# - Spread inverted on chart: tighter spread = higher on chart = EUR positive
#
# Data: EURUSD daily, German 10Y monthly (FRED IRLTLT01DEM156N),
#       Italian 10Y monthly (FRED IRLTLT01ITM156N), ffilled to daily
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
eurusd = src.c
idx = index()

# German 10Y yield (monthly, OECD via FRED, observation date indexing)
de10_src = economic_indicators(series_id='IRLTLT01DEM156N')()
de10 = ffill(de10_src.result)

# Italian 10Y yield (monthly, OECD via FRED, observation date indexing)
it10_src = economic_indicators(series_id='IRLTLT01ITM156N')()
it10 = ffill(it10_src.result)

# BTP-Bund spread: Italy 10Y minus Germany 10Y
# Invert so tighter spread = higher value (aligns with EURUSD direction)
btp_bund_spread = -(it10 - de10)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: EURUSD and Inverted BTP-Bund Spread Overlay
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Does the ECB Fragmentation Pledge Matter? BTP-Bund Says Yes',
    category='EUR Peripheral Stress',
    y_axis_label='Inverted BTP-Bund Spread (%)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Inverted BTP-Bund 10Y Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EURUSD', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(btp_bund_spread, eurusd))
